segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הָאָב תּוֹלֵשׁ וּמַאֲכִיל לְכׇל מִי שֶׁיִּרְצֶה, וּמַה שֶּׁהִנִּיחַ תָּלוּשׁ – הֲרֵי הוּא שֶׁל יוֹרְשִׁין.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In continuation of the case discussed in the previous mishna of a father who wrote a document granting his property to his son but reserved the rights to the produce during his lifetime, the mishna states that «the father may detach» produce from the land «and feed» the produce «to whomever he wishes, and what he left detached» at the time of his death «belongs to» all the father’s «heirs,» not only to this son.

moves.summary: father may pick produce; detached produce at death goes to heirs

positions.claim: the father may pick and feed whomever he wishes; what is left detached belongs to the heirs
